title: 🐱 Loveland Cats Ready for Adoption - From Cuddly Companions to Working Whiskers - NewsBreak
text:
8 hours ago Looking to add a furry friend to your family? Loveland has some wonderful cats waiting for loving homes — from lap cats to playful pairs and even a few hard-working mousers. Here are some of the adoptable cats you can meet today:
Snickers Breed: Domestic Mediumhair
Age: Adult
Gender: Male
Color: Black & White (Tuxedo)
Adoption Fee: $1
Shelter: For Adoption By Private Owner (Loveland, CO)
Snickers is full of personality! He greets visitors at the door, loves to be held like a baby, and even gives hugs. He’s bonded with his brother Pumpkin — they sleep, play, and eat together. These two are looking for a home where they can stay side by side.
👉 Meet Snickers and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Pumpkin Breed: American Shorthair
Age: Adult
Gender: Male
Color: Orange or Red (Mostly)
Adoption Fee: $1
Shelter: For Adoption By Private Owner (Loveland, CO)
Pumpkin is a sweet cuddler who loves to curl up in your lap. He’s a little shy at first but finds comfort in his brother Snickers. The two are inseparable and would love to be adopted together.
👉 Meet Pumpkin and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Autumn Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: Brown Tabby
Shelter: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus
Phone: (970) 226-3647
Autumn is a gentle soul who loves sunny naps and quiet moments. She has a great history with other cats, dogs, and kids — a perfect fit for a friendly household.
👉 Meet Autumn and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Rick Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Young
Gender: Male
Color: Brown Tabby
Shelter: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus
Phone: (970) 226-3647
Rick is a playful, silly young cat who enjoys the company of other cats, kids, and dogs. He’s ready to bring fun and energy to his new home.
👉 Meet Rick and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Morty Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Young
Gender: Male
Color: Brown Tabby
Shelter: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus
Phone: (970) 226-3647
Morty is another fun-loving tabby who’s great with other pets and kids. He’s full of curiosity and would love a home where he can play and explore.
👉 Meet Morty and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Lynx Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Adult
Gender: Male
Color: Brown Tabby
Shelter: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus
Phone: (970) 226-3647
Lynx is a friendly cat who warms up quickly once he feels comfortable. He prefers to be the only cat in the home and would do best without small animals. He’s also a great little hunter!
👉 Meet Lynx and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Spider-Gwen Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: Gray/Blue Tabby
Shelter: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus
Phone: (970) 226-3647
Spider-Gwen is a working cat who prefers outdoor life. She’s ideal for barns, sheds, or other spaces where she can help control rodents while enjoying her independence.
👉 Meet Spider-Gwen and apply to adopt on adoptapet
